page.notes: Entries are in two columns; the left column is copied from top to bottom, then the right. Long s is written as plain s throughout, so "ineffentialem", "quorespe-" and similar forms appear as "inessentialem", "quoresspe-". The printed "quoresspe-" is copied as printed for the hyphenated line break. The "&" glyphs are printed as the ampersand sign. The handwritten number at the top right is not printed text and is left out. Several numbers and words are doubtful in the small italic type: "48[?]" (first entry number), "coaturna[?]", "praemii[?]", and the reading "an detur" are marked. Lines are transcribed as printed, with the printer's hyphens kept at line ends. The line "Metaphysica" continues on the page, which is not visible in this part.
